note: Large private RV park off Hwy 643 near Gibbons, 15 minutes north-east of Edmonton, with groomed riverside walking trails along the Sturgeon River, propane, firewood and optional site landlines. It sells nights but mostly serves long-term and worksite guests, with weekly, monthly and seasonal sites. --Claude
